name: OK! Lunches!
source:
Another spinoff of OTChi Kocchi. This time around, the protagonist, Shirou, has a random encounter for lunch with four supporting characters...

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23896]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
这是《OTChi Kocchi》的另一部外传。这一次，主人公士郎与四名配角偶然相遇，一起吃了午饭……

[译自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23896]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
